description: Edit this sheet of six small chibi pixel art figures sitting on the ground: in the top row one sits facing the viewer, one sits facing away from the viewer, one sits facing the viewer with the hands at the chest; in the bottom row one sits facing the viewer with the hands at the mouth and two sit facing away. Dress every figure in the same outfit and change nothing else: keep each figure's pose, size, place, bald head, ears and face exactly as they are, with the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The outfit is a vampire count's: a fitted black jacket with long sleeves to the wrist and short tails at the back, a stiff crimson-lined stand-up collar kept below the chin, a dark crimson waistcoat with a row of small silver buttons, a white cravat at the throat, a crimson knee-length skirt layered with black lace over black stockings, and polished black boots with small silver buckles, and a long black cape with crimson lining hanging from the shoulders and folded behind the back, ending above the ground: nothing of the outfit, cape or skirt, reaches lower than each seated figure's own lowest pixels, which stay exactly where they are. Seen from behind, the cape covers the back with its plain black outside. The hands stay bare and keep their place. Transparent background, nothing else added.
